content: Amedya n ɛecra n teɛzariyyin
“Xenni ad tiři Tgeldit n ijenwan amecnaw ɛecra n teɛzariyyin iwyent řefnarat nsent, ffɣent, ḥima ad mmeřqent ak-d wesři d tesřit.
Xemsa zzaysent d timiɣisin u xemsa d tifɣař.
Tinni iǧan d tifɣař ksint řefnarat nsent, maca war iwyint ca zzect.
Timiɣisin iwyent-i-dd zzect di tziyyatin nsent ak-d řefnarat nsent.
Řami iɛḍeř umuřay, bdant ttnudument marra uca ṭṭṣent.
Di řwesṭ n ǧiřet tuɣa din tɣuyyit: ‘Xzarem, aqa amuřay yusa-dd, ffɣem-dd, ad t teřqam!’
Xenni kkarent teɛzariyyin nni, ssewjdent-i-dd řefnarat nsent.
Tifɣař nnant i tmiɣisin: ‘Wcent aneɣ zi zzect nkent minzi řefnarat nneɣ xesyent.’
Arrint-i-dd xasent tmiɣisin, nnant: ‘Ɛemmarṣ, war d aneɣ ittqeddi i neccin d kennint. Ruḥent ɣar isebbaben, maḥend ad tesɣent i yixef nkent.’
Řami ruḥent nitenti ḥima ad sɣent, yusa-dd umuřay, u tinni tuɣa iwejden udfent akides ɣar taddart n řefraḥet n wurar uca tbelleɛ tewwart.
Awarni man aya usint teɛzariyyin nneɣni, qqarent: ‘A siditneɣ, a siditneɣ, arzem aneɣ!’
Netta yarra-dd, inna: ‘S tidett, necc ad akent iniɣ, war kennint ssineɣ.’
S uyenni ḥḍam, minzi kenniw war tessinem ca ass uřa d tasaɛɛet.”
Amedya n talintat
“Minzi tamesřact am yijj n bnadem isafar barra i temmurt nnes, iřaɣa-dd x imsexxaren nnes uca ikellef i-ten x wagřa nnes.
Iwca i yijjen xemsa talint, i wenneɣni tnayen, i wenni wiss třata icten n talint, kuř ijjen ɛlaḥsab tizemmar nnes, řexdenni ikkar, isafar deɣya.
Iruḥ wenni iṭṭfen xemsa talint, isebbeb daysen uca yarbeḥ xemsa.
Amenni ɛawed wenni iṭṭfen tnayen talint, yarbeḥ tnayen nneɣni.
Maca wenni iṭṭfen ict n talint, iruḥ, iɣza di temmurt uca issnuffar tmenyat n nnuqart n bab nnes.
Řami teɛdu aṭṭas n řweqt yusa-dd bab n imsexxaren nni uca igga akidsen řeḥsab.
Xenni yusa-dd wenni iṭṭfen xemsa talint, yiwi-dd xemsa talint nneɣni, inna: ‘A sidi, tewcid ayi xemsa talint, aqa da, arebḥeɣ xemsa nneɣni ktar.’
Yarra-dd xas bab nnes, inna: ‘Mliḥ i teggid, a amsexxar aṣebḥan d amtiqqi. Tuɣa cek d amtiqqi x drus, ad ac ggeɣ x waṭṭas, adef-dd ɣar řefraḥet n sidi nnec.’
Xenni yusa-dd ɛawed wenni iṭṭfen tnayen talint, inna: ‘A sidi, tewcid ayi tnayen talint, aqa arebḥeɣ tnayen nneɣni ktar.’
Inna as sidi nnes: ‘Mliḥ i teggid, a amsexxar aṣebḥan d amtiqqi. Tuɣa cek d amtiqqi x drus, ad ac ggeɣ x waṭṭas, adef-dd ɣar řefraḥet n sidi nekk.’
Maca wenni iṭṭfen ict n talint, yusa-dd ɛawed, inna: ‘A sidi, ssneɣ aqa cek d bnadem tqesḥed, tmejjared mani war tzarrɛed, tyarrwed mani war tᵉssarwated.
S uyenni ggʷedeɣ uca ruḥeɣ, ssnuffareɣ talint nnec di temmurt. Aɣac tenni nnec.’
Yarra-dd sidi nnes, inna as: ‘A amsexxar aɛeffan ameɛguz, aqa tessned belli aqa mjareɣ mani war zarɛeɣ u yarweɣ mani war ssarweteɣ.
Xenni mři tiwyed nnuqart inu ɣar řbanku, xenni necc, xmi dd ɣa yaseɣ, ad ttareɣ min iǧan inu s arriba.
S uya kksem as talint nni, ewc i-tt i wenni ɣar iǧa ɛecra talint!’
Minzi i kuř ijjen wenni ɣar iǧa ad as immewc uca ad ɣares yiři s waṭṭas, maca wenni war ɣar iǧi, uřa d min ɣares ad as ittwakkes.
Nḍarem amsexxar ibeṭṭřen ɣar barra deg uneggar n taǧest mani ɣa iřin imeṭṭawen d uɣezzi n teɣmas.”
Řḥukm n Mmis n Bnadem x iḥuřiyyen u x iɣayḍen
“Xmi dd ɣa yas Mmis n bnadem deg uɛuǧi nnes u marra lmalakat nnes iqeddsen akides, xenni ad iqqim x řɛarc n uɛuǧi nnes.
Ad ssmunen marra řegnus qibač nnes uca Netta ad ten imssebḍa am mammec ameksaw issbeṭṭa iḥuřiyyen x iɣayḍen.
Netta ad igg iḥuřiyyen x ufusi nnes, maca iɣayḍen x uzeřmaḍ nnes.
Řexdenni ad ini Ujeǧid i yinni x ufusi nnes: ‘Asem-dd, a kenniw inni ittwabarken zi Baba, wartem Tageldit i d awem dd-iwejden zeg wami tᵉttwagg ddunect.
Minzi tuɣa dayi řaẓ uca kenniw tesseccem ayi. Tuɣa ffudeɣ, tewcim ayi ad sweɣ. Tuɣa ayi d abarrani, kenniw tesszedɣem ayi,
tuɣa ayi d aɛaryan, kenniw tessyarḍem ayi, tuɣa heřceɣ, kenniw tessijem-dd xafi, tuɣa ayi di řeḥbes, kenniw tusim-dd ɣari.’
Xenni ad xas dd-arren imseggaden, qqaren: ‘A Siditneɣ, meřmi Cek neẓra tǧuẓed uca nessecc i Cek, niɣ meřmi Cek neẓra tᵉffuded uca newc ac ad teswed?
Meřmi Cek neẓra d abarrani uca nessezdeɣ i Cek, niɣ d aɛaryan uca nessyarḍ i Cek?
Meřmi Cek neẓra theřced niɣ di řeḥbes uca nusa-dd ɣarek?’
Ad dd-yarr ujeǧid, ad asen yini: ‘S tidett, Necc ad awem iniɣ, min i teggim i yijjen zeg wawmaten imeẓyanen inu, i Necc umi t teggim.’
Řexdenni ad yini i yinni iǧan x uzeřmaḍ nnes: ‘Beɛɛdem xafi, a kenniw inni ittwaneɛřen, ɣar tmessi n řebda i iwejden i ibřis d lmalakat nnes.
Minzi tuɣa dayi řaẓ war d ayi tesseccem, ffudeɣ war d ayi tewcim ad sweɣ.
tuɣa ayi d abarrani, kenniw war d ayi tesszedɣem, tuɣa ayi d aɛaryan, war d ayi tessyarḍem, heřceɣ u ttwaḥebseɣ war xafi dd-tessijem ca.’
Řexdenni uřa d nitni ad xas dd-arren, ad inin: ‘A Siditneɣ, meřmi Cek neẓra teǧuẓed niɣ tᵉffuded niɣ d abarrani niɣ d aɛaryan niɣ theřced niɣ di řeḥbes, xenni neccin war xak nsexxar ca?’
Xenni ad xasen dd-yarr, ad yini: ‘S tidett, Necc ad awem iniɣ: Min war teggim i yijjen zeg imeẓyanen inu, i Necc umi war t teggim ɛawed.’
Ad raḥen nitni ɣar řeɛdab ittduman, maca imseggaden ɣar Tudart ittduman.”
